verdict.rationale: Solo 2 requires a physical touch on its capacitive sensor to confirm operations, across FIDO2/WebAuthn passkeys, PIV and OpenPGP. That makes it a usable human-presence primitive. However, nothing in the evidence shows it gating automated or agent-initiated actions; you would have to wire the touch requirement into agent workflows yourself through standard protocols. Missing for 10: documented integration or examples for agent and automation approval flows, and independent hands-on corroboration of the touch-confirm behavior in such use.
